# Hope in Time of Abandonment

*[Jacques Ellul](../philosophers/ellul.md) · 1972*

A theological essay in which [Ellul](../philosophers/ellul.md) describes a time when God seems silent, and sets against optimism, the confidence that things will work out, hope, which arises when there is nothing left to expect and translates into action.
